answer.reason: Acts 28 tells what happened at Rome when Paul came there as a prisoner and stayed two years preaching.

clauses.english: was where Paul, a prisoner, was allowed to dwell with a soldier guarding him
clauses.quote: Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him

clauses.english: was where Paul preached the kingdom of God for two years, no man forbidding him
clauses.quote: Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house

doubts: Verses that only mention Rome in passing (ACT 2:10, ACT 19:21, ACT 23:11, ACT 25:25, ROM 1:7, ROM 15:24) or as the place a letter was written (the closing notes of GAL, EPH, PHP, COL, 2TI, PHM) were left out.
ACT 18:2 (Claudius commanding the Jews to depart) is already in the summary and was not made a clause.
